meta.title: Cookie Policy
meta.subtitle: Asian Spices Online B.V. uses cookies and similar technologies on our website, webshop, and app. In this policy, you can read which types of cookies we use, why, and what choices you have.

support.heading: Questions about cookies?
support.text: Contact our customer service team for questions about our use of cookies.

blocks.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website or app. They are used to make the website function properly, remember your preferences, and, with your consent, analyze the use of our services.

sections.title: 2. Which categories of cookies do we use?

blocks.text: These cookies are required for the website and webshop to function properly, for example, to remember your shopping cart, login details, and cookie preferences. You cannot turn off these cookies because the website will not function correctly without them. No consent is required for these cookies. See Section 3 for the complete overview of these cookies, including names and retention periods.
With your consent, we use analytical cookies to understand how visitors use our website so that we can improve it.

items: Google Tag Manager – manages the placement of tags/cookies on the website
Google Analytics 4 (GA4) – collects anonymized or pseudonymous statistics about website usage
Microsoft Clarity – analyzes user behavior (e.g., mouse movements and scroll behavior) to improve the user experience

blocks.text: GA4 has applied IP anonymization by default since 2022 (IP addresses are not fully stored). For the use of Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity, Asian Spices maintains a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with Google and Microsoft respectively, as required under the GDPR. These agreements are accepted via the account settings of both services before the respective cookies become active on the website.

Asian Spices currently does not use marketing/advertising cookies (e.g., Google Ads remarketing, Meta/Facebook Pixel). Should this change in the future, this policy will be updated and consent will be requested again.

Apart from necessary cookies, Asian Spices currently does not use additional functional cookies (e.g., for language preference). Should this change, for example upon adding a “recently viewed products” feature, this policy will be updated.

Based on the tools that Asian Spices already uses (Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, and Microsoft Clarity — see section 2.2), these services use the following standard cookies documented by Google and Microsoft:

rows: Keeps the customer session active (e.g., login status)
Remembers the contents of the shopping cart
Up to 30 or 90 days (see Privacy Policy)
Persists the Clarity user ID between visits
Groups multiple page views into a single session recording
Identifies whether this is the first time Clarity sees this user
Identifies unique browsers across Microsoft domains
Supporting technical cookies for Clarity functionality

blocks.text: Please note: The exact names of the session, cart, and consent cookies depend on the platform and consent tool that Asian Spices uses. Once the website is live, we recommend confirming this table with a technical cookie scan (e.g., via Cookiebot or Complianz) to verify that no additional cookies are placed.
On your first visit to our website, we ask for consent for non-necessary cookies via a cookie banner. You can:
You can change your cookie preferences at any time via the “Cookie Settings” link in the footer of our website.

We retain your cookie choice and proof of consent for 6 months (in accordance with our Privacy Policy, Chapter 8). In case of significant changes in the cookies used, purposes, or vendors, we will ask for your choice again.

In addition to our cookie banner, you can also manage cookies through your browser settings, for example, by blocking or deleting cookies. Please keep in mind that blocking necessary cookies may limit the functionality of our website.
We may update this cookie policy when we deploy new technologies or when laws and regulations change. The most up-to-date version is published on our website.
See also our Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle personal data.
